$comment: Invariant ids owned by the P1 task `p1-session-runtime` (packages/core/src/session). The integrate task merges these into docs/invariants-owned.json, which is what `pnpm test:coverage-map` reads; this file is the per-task claim so two lanes cannot silently claim the same id or drop one between them. `resolutions` records where two registry rows disagree and which reading this lane implements — a refuter rejected an earlier cut for testing a weaker property than its own falsifier's case named, so the reading is written down rather than inferred from the test.

notOwned.INV-COM-05: the width/colour tween is a UI-layer S invariant (packages/ui, P3), not a runtime one
notOwned.INV-SCH-06: the scheduler lane owns the endgame generator; session/ only asserts the generation half

stubs: GradingPort — implemented by packages/core/src/grading (other P1 lane); session/test-doubles.ts ships ScriptedGrading against the real interface.
SchedulerPort — implemented by packages/core/src/scheduler (other P1 lane); session/test-doubles.ts ships RecordingScheduler.
FlavourMatrixPort — the plan puts the flavour matrix in packages/core/src/economy; DEFAULT_FLAVOUR_MATRIX is the in-lane source until that lands.
SessionStore — the SQLite table and migration belong to packages/schema; InMemorySessionStore is the reference implementation the properties run against.

resolutions.ruling: EC-SES-22 explicitly WIDENS INV-SESS-07's one-row-per-course_id key to (course_id, session_kind, node_ref) and replaces 'one graded session per course' with 'only one graded session is ever IN FLIGHT'. The resolved property this lane tests is therefore: any number of graded rows may be STORED (one per key) because that is what parking is (EC-SES-07 'two courses each hold a suspended session', EC-SES-10 'the other course's session is parked, not discarded'), and at most one is ACTIVE globally. InMemorySessionStore.put never refuses and never evicts; store.activate() is what enforces the one-in-flight bound, and requestStart() opens the guard sheet. The earlier cut read 'in flight' as 'stored', threw on the second graded row, and made EC-SES-10 unreachable for a lesson — and its own committed falsifier dodged that by using story rows.
owningTests: store.test.ts [INV-SESS-07] two courses each hold a parked GRADED session…
store.test.ts [INV-SESS-07] for any interleaving of two courses…

resolutions.ruling: 'Recycled twice — mid-lesson in a different format, at the end in the original' is a claim about POSITION, not only format. `RecyclePhase` is computed from whether the main queue has drained, and the mid-lesson replay is inserted after `midLessonRecycleGap` (= 2, MID_LESSON_RECYCLE_GAP in flavours.ts) further MAIN-queue answers, with main items still to come. The product map calls the different-format mid-lesson replay 'best-effort': when a miss lands with fewer than `gap` main items remaining there is no mid-lesson slot, and BOTH recycles are served at the end in the original format. The COUNT is exactly two in every case.
owningTests: machine.test.ts [INV-MIS-01] the FIRST recycle is served MID-LESSON…
machine.test.ts [INV-MIS-01] for any miss position in any lesson length…
machine.test.ts [INV-MIS-01] a miss with no mid-lesson slot left…

resolutions.ruling: All three producers emit into ONE queue (`emitInterstitials`), and `route()` no longer filters the mistake-review producer out. The queue is rendered a screen at a time; the combo and step-up screens render as the `interstitial` shell state and the mistake-review screen as the `mistakeReview` shell state S029 declares in its own right, carrying S049's plural-aware copy key on `state.mistakeReviewCopyKey` (MISTAKE_REVIEW_COPY_ONE / _MANY) so the copy slot has a source the UI can read.
owningTests: machine.test.ts [INV-COM-08] driven through step(), the boundary that trips all three producers…

resolutions.ruling: The tier-2 note is carried on `Answer.note` AND on the persisted `SessionState.lastVerdict`, so a restored `banner.softCorrect` restores WITH its headline (INV-SESS-04). Previously `grade()` read `verdict.kind` and discarded `verdict.note`, so S044's soft-note pool had no carrier in the runtime and only the combo half of this invariant was tested.
owningTests: machine.test.ts [INV-COM-09] a soft-correct crossing a milestone renders the tier-2 note as the banner headline…

resolutions.ruling: The step-up copy key is READ FROM `config.stepUp`, so 'the less-sound copy never appears outside an audio-only flavour' is a property of the code and is tested over BOTH StepUpKind values with a synthetic config. Recorded honestly: no row of DEFAULT_FLAVOUR_MATRIX declares `stepUp: 'audio'` today — the audio-only hub flavours are P4 — so an assertion over the ten shipped rows alone would be vacuous, which is what it was before.
owningTests: flavours.test.ts [INV-COM-12] the step-up copy is READ FROM the flavour config…
